_note: Single source of truth for update-counts.mjs. The script reads 'cleaned' and 'artefacts_dropped' to know what to replace and writes 'cleaned', 'raw', and 'last_updated' back after a successful run. Only edit 'artefacts_dropped' manually — it is a pipeline constant (count of content-free records Stage 5 removes) that does NOT come from the API. 'version' (vYYYY.MM) and 'last_updated' are also rewritten on every data change and drive the dataset version tag and JSON-LD dateModified across the site.
